tagline: Any screen, read like a well-typeset terminal
brief: A domain-agnostic design system: flat, ruled, square, mono labels over sans text, one orange accent for the current thing. The mark has to carry those laws on its own.
criteria: Square and flat (radius 0), one accent with one meaning, distinct from the >_ terminal cliché, legible at 16 px, works on both themes.

concepts.name: Current cell
concepts.idea: A ruled grid where one cell is the cursor, in the accent, and the next cell is still empty.
rationale: Flat, square and ruled: the system's first two laws, drawn
The only orange is the current thing, exactly as in the UI
The empty last cell says what comes next; no >_ cliché
Wordmark built from 2-unit rectangles, x-height = one cell

next_steps: Use the grid as a loading or empty-state motif (cells fill, cursor steps)
